title: Screwtape: Adversarial Transcript Editing for Monitor Red-Teaming
abstract: arXiv:2610.20941v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Screwtape, a pipeline that converts real agent transcripts into attacks that evade action-only monitors. An LLM attacker edits a transcript so that the agent causes a specified harm, such as leaking an API key or spawning an unmonitored agent. The edited actions are never executed, so we use an LLM verifier to reject attacks that are inconsistent with the original transcript or below a severity bar. The attacker revises the edit until the monitor no longer flags it. We applied Screwtape to 94 Claude Code and Codex transcripts from Redwood Research staff, optimizing against our own monitors. Across 252 runs, it produced 35 attacks that passed the verifier and evaded these monitors. Six of them, confirmed valid by human review, also evaded a held-out monitor provided by a frontier developer. We therefore demonstrate that a red-teamer without access to a developer's infrastructure can find confirmed failures of the developer's

translated_title: Screwtape：用于监控器红队测试的对抗性转录编辑
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Screwtape，这是一个将真实的智能体转录转换为能够规避纯动作监控器的攻击样本的流水线。一个LLM攻击者通过编辑转录，使智能体造成指定的危害，例如泄露API密钥或生成一个未被监控的智能体。由于编辑后的动作从未被实际执行，我们使用一个LLM验证器来拒绝那些与原始转录不一致或低于严重性门槛的攻击。攻击者会不断修改编辑内容，直到监控器不再将其标记。我们将Screwtape应用于来自Redwood Research员工的94份Claude Code和Codex转录，并针对我们自己的监控器进行优化。在252次运行中，它产生了35个通过验证器并成功规避这些监控器的攻击。其中六个经人工审查确认有效，同时也规避了一个由前沿AI开发者提供的保留监控器。因此，我们证明了无法访问开发者基础设施的红队测试人员也可以发现开发者监控器的已确认失效情况。
tldr: Screwtape流水线通过LLM对真实智能体转录进行对抗性编辑来生成规避监控器的攻击样本，证明红队测试人员无需访问开发者基础设施即可发现其安全监控器的确认失效漏洞。
